validity.researcher_notes: Independently verified without citing the wiki. The sheet's own already-cited Start/Status ref (youm7, 2023-07-10) explicitly states GASCO ('الشركة المصرية للغازات الطبيعية') built and operates both pipeline segments in this project (the 70km Raven-Rashid line AND the 5km/18in spur to the Ameriya butane plant specifically: 'شركة جاسكو قد قامت بإنشاء خط... بالإضافة إلى مد وصلة بطول 5 كم وقطر 18 بوصة لنقل غازات حقل ريفين لمصنع بوتاجاز العامرية'). Cross-checked against two independent, previously-uncited outlets that both name GASCO as the executing/operating entity for this same 5km Ameriya connector: attaqa.net (Arabic energy trade press, 2022-09-25 launch article — 'نفذت [جاسكو]... مد وصلة بطول 5 كيلومترات لنقل غازات حقل ريفين إلى مصنع البوتاجاز بالعامرية') and Egypt Oil & Gas (English trade press, covering the same launch). This matches the sheet's own naming convention for GASCO elsewhere on the operators/owners tab ('Egyptian Natural Gas Co', e.g. P0436 Arab Gas Pipeline, P7588 Edfu Gas Pipeline) as distinct from Owner 'Egyptian Natural Gas Holding Co' (EGAS) — the standard GASCO-operator vs EGAS-owner attribution split already documented as a recurring, row-specific pattern in Egypt gas (not a class-wide issue). Sheet's Operator cell being blank was simply an unfilled field, not a wiki/sheet factual disagreement.

fills.researcher_notes: This is an OPERATORS/OWNERS TAB fill (ProjectID-keyed), not the main GGIT gas tab — the main tab has no Operator column. Owner ('Egyptian Natural Gas Holding Co [100%]') on both tabs is unaffected and correct; this only fills the previously-blank Operator/Operator[ref] cells with GASCO, named consistently with existing sheet convention ('Egyptian Natural Gas Co') per two independent sources (one Arabic trade outlet, one English trade outlet) both confirming GASCO specifically built/operates this 5km Raven-Ameriya spur, not just the broader Western Desert complex.
